3D animation

The cinematic entrance is rendered in real time with Three.js, licensed under the MIT License. Pipework, water droplets, lighting and the environment are assembled and animated in code. It contains no live-action footage.

The unbranded van is adapted from Innerscene’s cargo panel van, released under CC0. Its geometry is optimized with gltfpack. Pavement uses Asphalt 02 by Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven, under CC0. See animation asset notes. Quiet rain and drip audio is synthesized locally.
